steps: Deployed the program to devnet (upgrade authority is the lab wallet)

Fetched config: admin and treasury are the lab wallet, registration_period=31536000
init_token_config with lab $NAIM mint A9keuhfy… (6 decimals; all fees 0, treasury_bps=10000; token_config BWmYXFwX…, stakers vault 7TZegKxQ…)

evidence.functional_evidence: initialize landed and the config was read back; init_token_config pinned lab mint A9keuhfy58ayz3SsovWahrX2cGwJFqx14h45KUtjNNCt; register_name wrote name-record AzM1S31crSSqo2R6ifk4ZEoemW9TAdWdV7NFcpGw27eB for campus-scout (owner=lab wallet, verified=false); InvalidConfig, a second initialize, and NameAlreadyRegistered were rejected.
evidence.ui_check: The hosted page is the generic IDL console (connect Phantom or Solflare on devnet). It was not driven in headless Chromium in this run; initialize, init_token_config and register_name were sent with the lab wallet through the IDL client in tests/devnet/naim.mjs.

limitations: Staking, renew, and the list/buy marketplace were not exercised in this run. collect_fee is a no-op when the registration fee is 0, so no payer $NAIM ATA funding was required beyond the init_if_needed vault ATAs. The registered name is unverified (verified=false).
